$comment: Single source of truth for the editor's font registry. Add a font by dropping its .ttf in public/fonts/ and appending an entry here — no code change. `defaults` lists the ids loaded at boot (keep this minimal: one Latin + one dual-script Arabic for a fast interactive boot); every other font lazy-loads (JIT) the first time it is picked. `defaults[0]` is the seed/primary face. URLs are relative to the document base, so they survive a deploy under a subpath. As of issue #23 the engine's FontFamily is string-backed, so ANY id registered here renders when applied — the engine resolves the loaded face by id (no hardcoded allowlist). `cairo` is the worked example of a JIT, non-default custom font. Issue #329: `substitutes` lists the faces the engine's font-substitution table (text_pipeline::SUBSTITUTIONS) maps document families to — Carlito for Calibri, Caladea for Cambria, Liberation Serif / Mono for Times New Roman / Courier New, Gelasio for Georgia, Selawik for Segoe UI, Noto Naskh Arabic for Simplified Arabic and for Arabic text in Arial / Times New Roman. The boot sequence loads them next to `defaults` so an opened document lays out in metric-compatible faces; their SIL OFL licences ship under fonts/licenses/.
